media.alt_text: LGBTI flags flying on Parliament forecourt

post.text: NZ Parliament @NZParliament May 16, 2018 Usually our flags #OnTheForecourt welcome international visitors, but today we're flying the #LGBTI flags for the International Day Against Homophobia, Biphobia, Intersexism & Transphobia (#IDAHOBIT) – the first time the intersex flag has been flown by a national parliament.
